description: This file defines the RecipeActivity class for an Android app, responsible for displaying recipe details and initiating cooking actions. It loads recipe data, displays images and steps, and handles menu interactions.

classes.name: RecipeActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that manages recipe display and user interactions for cooking recipes.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles activity start, retrieves the recipe name from the intent, and loads the recipe.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and gets references to UI components.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, triggering actions like starting the cooking process.

methods.name: loadRecipe
methods.description: Loads the recipe JSON asset and parses it into a Recipe object, then displays it.

methods.name: displayRecipe
methods.description: Updates UI elements to present the recipe's title, image, ingredients, and steps with animations.

methods.name: startCooking
methods.description: Creates an intent to start the RecipeService to begin cooking the loaded recipe.
